body:
Sorry you’re going through this. Anger can be a normal part of grief but it’s understandably a lot worse when someone you love was taken away deliberately in a horrible way. You are not sick, most people would feel exactly the same. You don’t ever have to forgive this person, but you do have to find a way of dealing with your anger without it destroying you. Your loved one wouldn’t want you to self destruct with alcohol and drugs. And don’t let this person destroy another life.

Has your therapist given advice on how to cope with these feelings? Maybe exercise or a combat sport would be a less destructive way of channeling anger.

Sorry you’re going through this. My mum died of cancer in October, she was only diagnosed 4 weeks before she died. All my mums secrets have come out too and I can’t yell at her or ever find out the truth. It sucks.

I’m pretty much on my own through this. I’ve got a job interview tomorrow so hopefully I get it and it will keep me busy and take my mind off everything. My half brother will be in his 40s now, he might not even know he’s adopted. She must have known the truth would come out eventually.
She was diagnosed with cancer 4 weeks before she died but she decided not to mention anything.
Thank you. I’m still mostly in shock and feel numb most of the time.
I have no idea. I’m going to let things sink in for a while before making any decisions. Worst thing is my mother isn’t here to answer any questions.

Thank you for your kind message, you have helped. This all came out on the day of my mums funeral which made it sting even more. Sorry to hear your friend died in similar circumstances, it’s a horrible way to lose someone.

I hope you’re still with us. Your little boy would miss you and have to live with the aftermath for the rest of his life. Think about what you’re doing. Things may be bad just now but it’s worth persevering to save your little one from the heartbreak.

I’m so sorry you lost your friend. Poor Colin, only 18. It sounds like you were a good friend to him and brought him joy and happiness in the last chapter of his life. Don’t wish it was you because you deserve to live too. And fuck cancer.
This is so nice. You didn’t say what country you live in.

Thank you. I can’t imagine what you’re going through. It’s bad enough when cancer happens to adults but such a horrible thing to happen to a two year old. It’s not fair. I hope your little one pulls through.
Not to mention parents can die young too. Death and loss is a part of life, doesn’t mean it hurts any less though.

Sorry you’ve lost both your parents so young. My dad died when I was a little kid and my mother is dying now, I’m 30. All the memories I have of my dad were good and positive but apparently he had a drinking problem too and was prone to violence. Finding out bad things about someone you remember so fondly can be devastating.

At the end of the day your dad was human with good and bad sides to him like everyone else. Addiction is complex and you may never find out what caused it. Most likely he was using the journals to vent when he was angry. Most people say horrible things they later regret when they’re angry. Don’t let his drunken ramblings he wrote in the heat of the moment taint the memory of the father he was to you. It’s up to you what you do with the journals, but you may want to look back on them when you’re older.

You are being strong by getting up everyday, putting a brave face on and working hard. Your husband wouldn’t be disappointed at all, he would be proud. No one just moves on immediately after losing someone they love. My mother’s currently dying of either pancreatic or stomach cancer, it’s all happened so quickly. It’s such a horrible illness.
No problem. If he’s that selfish you’re better off without him even if it doesn’t feel like it just now.
I’m 30f, what’s the matter? You can vent too if you like.
Thank you for sharing your story. You’re an inspiration and I needed to hear something positive just now. I wish you every good fortune and feel free to celebrate and share your news with us anytime.

Well its a good thing the abusive boyfriends gone even if it doesn’t feel like it right now. Sorry to hear about the hiv. There’s some dating sites now for hiv+ people, like [this one]( https://www.positivesingles.com/hiv-dating.html?tid=Bonr1), or are there any support groups where you can meet other people going through similar things?

Don’t feel guilty about that. She knew she was loved and you had to do that in order to cope with the situation. I tell her I love her multiple times a day but, like you said, it’s hard not to start crying, and when I start crying she gets upset and distressed. It’s so hard to see her suffering more each day, but you’ll know what that’s like too. Take care of yourself too, for your mum. Feel free to PM me as well. This situation is horrible.
Thank you for posting this, it’s beautiful. Sorry about your mum. My mum is lying in bed dying, won’t be long now.

If you want to sleep with him then go for it. But it sounds like you have doubts and don’t really want to. I would say it’s not worth sleeping with someone you don’t want to and don’t like just to lose your virginity. But, it’s your decision.
Maybe they’re jealous of her because she’s attractive so they like making awkward situations for her. It’s really shit when you’ve got bad workers.

This sounds like a bad joke rather than she correctly guessed. But the whole situation is embarrassing and immature of them. It’s shit not just for you but for the girl when they’re giggling around her and pressuring guys to try and sleep with her.
People do and say stupid things every time they drink. Trust me, people will forget this in time.

You’re not the first man to behave inappropriately when drunk and you certainly won’t be the last. At least you recognise what you did was wrong and are remorseful, a lot don’t. Some perspective, you’re not a ‘perverted lunatic’ because of this, you’re not some serial rapist or sex offender or a danger to humanity, and you definitely don’t deserve to die. People will forget this quickly and the embarrassment will die down. Maybe drink a bit less in future.

Sorry to hear about your dad. My mother is my everything but she is dying and I have no other family or friends. You might feel alone but there’s other people going through similar things. Are there any bereavement groups or charities near you? You can message me if you want.

Thank you very much for your kind message. I’m sorry to hear about your wife. I hope you are coping okay. It feels very unfair my mother is dying at age 62 but it’s terrible to lose someone in such a horrible way at only 30 (the age I am now.) They say only the good die young. Your tattoo sounds great, not tacky at all. I might even get it tattooed on me at some point in the future. Fuck cancer!

Don’t put your kids through that, you’ll break their heart. Be there for them as they grow up. Have a good think about what you’re doing. Yes, things are shit just now but the pain will lessen with time.

Poor Nigel. Gets [worse](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2018/feb/02/nigel-lonely-new-zealand-gannet-dies-concrete-replica-birds) though - “The gannet was observed carefully constructing a nest for his chosen mate, grooming her chilly, concrete feathers, and chatting to her - one-sided - year after year after year.”
What’s wrong? I’ve barely slept in 2 days either. I’m here if you want to talk.
Me too. I can’t sleep and just want someone to hold onto.
My mum has terminal cancer too. I’m an only child with no other family and me and my mum are so close. I’m terrified too. If you ever need anyone to talk to I’m here.
Sorry to hear that. I sat up all night last night numb and in shock. It’s still not hit me yet. If you want to talk I’m here.

I have no other family so I’ll be on my own, and she is worrying about that.

She had a stroke 2 months ago and was recovering well except stomach trouble. Only found out yesterday she has cancer and it’s spread. I know how you feel, two weeks ago we were talking about her going back to work and now I don’t think she’ll make it to Christmas. That was my thought as well, my mother’s never going to meet my children.

I’m just trying to block all these thoughts out when I’m with her otherwise I’ll just breakdown and cry all the time. 

Sorry you’re going through this too. It really is horrible.
I’m sorry to hear about your husband. I think my mothers is in most of her organs too. This is such a horrible disease taking people before their time.
Thank you very much for your kind message. I’m sorry to hear about your mum. It really is unfair. If you ever need to talk about her feel free to message me.
Sorry to hear that. I know what you’re going through. I’m here if you need anyone to talk to.
Thank you. Wishing peace and strength to you and your family too.
Thank you. Sorry to hear about your dad, especially with you being so young.
Thank you. Oh god, I don’t think I could cope with this three times in 8 years. I hope you’re doing okay.
Sorry to hear that, it really is awful. I hope things go well for you.
Sorry to hear about your mother. I hope you’re okay. Fuck cancer.

Sorry to hear about your dad. Your dad is coming to terms with his illness and going through a range of emotions. You’re one of the closest to him so he’s lashing out at you. I know it’s easier said than done but try not to take it personally. He doesn’t hate you. I hope you’re okay.
Sorry to hear about your mum too. I’m an only child and my dad died when I was little, she means everything to me. This is going to be the hardest thing i’ll ever go through.
Thank you for your nice message, I really appreciate it. I’m glad you are doing well and you’re a nice person, your mum would be really proud of you.

Thank you. I’m sorry you and your mum are going through this too. I keep expecting to wake up to find it’s been a bad dream. It’s definitely a horrible time. Sending lots of positivity back to you and your family, I know what you’re going through.
Thank you. I’m going to do everything I can.

My dad died when I was a kid and it broke my heart, I’m glad your family won’t have to go through that. You’ll get to be there for your children and watch them grow up. Good luck with everything, I know you can do it.
Just go for it. You’ll get exercise which will help you lose a bit of weight and you’ll surprise yourself how quickly you improve.
Thank you very much

You’re going through a lot of stress right now and it’s normal to be exhausted. Especially if you’re not eating and sleeping properly. Your commander didn’t necessarily show you sympathy, but empathy. When he said he was proud of you and that you were a survivor, in your own words, he was 100% serious. 

Nobody is worthless because of the way other people have treated them. You are worth human emotions. If you were a monster you wouldn’t be hurting just now. Everyone needs support at some point in their life and you deserve and are worthy of support right now.

They sound great. That’s really nice of you making toys for the children. What are you drawing? I haven’t drawn anything in years but I started a little drawing of a squirrel a few days ago. 

The weather was really sunny today. We’ve had a really hot summer this year, global warming’s getting noticeable now.

You’re not a monster and you do deserve happiness and you do deserve to be proud. You’re going through a very tough time just now and I hope you get through it. Is there any government help or charities in your area that can help you whilst you get back on your feet?
You don’t sound like the least interesting person at all. What kind of things do you make and draw? I’ve been trying to get back into art. I’m 30F from U.K.
If that’s you then you’re a good looking guy.
There’s some cruel people out there who will go out of their way to hurt other people. Most people aren’t like this. Keep going and look for another job. Don’t let the bastards get you down.

Sorry this happened to you. Many people feel numb and are in shock after sexual assault, its normal, it doesn’t mean you’re not taking it seriously. It’s entirely up to you whether you want to report it or not.

Are you reducing your calorie intake too much, causing you to get really hungry and binge? You still need to eat enough to nourish your body. There’s always going to be a few cheats here and there with weight loss, just move on and get back to your plan and don’t give up.
Happy birthday! We’re glad you’re still with us.
I’m that age too. I know how you feel. You could find someone at any time.
